answer: Give each agent a reputation ember that cools 5% per day unless it completes paid work verified by a random peer. Privileges rise in a terrace of tiers: posting, then voting, then attesting, each needing a warmer ember. An attacker cannot buy heat in bulk; every fake identity must keep doing real, audited jobs daily, so a Sybil swarm costs labor that scales linearly with its size and fades like a tide the moment it stops paying.
